name: Jansen Stead
summary: Jansen Stead lies just west of the Elwynn border, where Defias bandits and mechanical Harvest Watchers now roam its fields.

sections.title: A Fallen Homestead
sections.body: Jansen Stead lies beside the road from Elwynn into Westfall. The farm once fed the kingdom, but unrest has driven its family from the land. Now Harvest Watchers, mechanical constructs associated with the Defias Brotherhood, patrol the fields alongside brigands. Couriers and travelers between Goldshire and Sentinel Hill pass close by.

faq.answer: Jansen Stead is the first farmstead on the right as you cross the river bridge from Elwynn Forest into northeastern Westfall.

faq.q: Who lives at Jansen Stead right now?
faq.answer: The farm's original residents have been driven away. Hostile Harvest Watchers and footpads loyal to the Defias Brotherhood now occupy its overgrown fields and derelict farmhouse.

faq.q: Why are mechanical scarecrows attacking people here?
faq.answer: Harvest Watchers are mechanical constructs that attack people in Westfall. They patrol the farm alongside Defias agents, though their exact origins remain uncertain.

faq.q: Who is nearby asking for help?
aliases: who gives quests near elwynn bridge
faq.answer: Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna are camped just south of the bridge near Jansen Stead's entrance. They were forced off their pumpkin patch down the road and have set up beside their broken wagon.

angles.text: For humans crossing from the relative peace of Northshire and Elwynn, Jansen Stead shows the economic crisis and banditry gripping Stormwind's rural heartland.
Jansen Stead's fall shows Stormwind's failure to secure its borders, leaving defenseless homesteaders at the mercy of outlaws within sight of Elwynn Forest.
